title: End-to-End Trust Chain
description: Follows assignment-bound program authoring, publication, trust enrollment, and House activation from genuinely empty stores.

title: Session Epoch Pattern
description: Captures a session generation before awaited work, then rejects completions if a lock or sign-out changed that session.
afterHeading: A lock must invalidate work already in flight

title: Strict Parsing of Untrusted Crypto Artifacts
description: Rejects unknown and duplicate fields, recomputes key fingerprints, requires canonical bytes, and clears temporary cryptographic buffers.
afterHeading: An incoming file must earn trust

title: Three-Phase Review → Confirm → Commit
description: Keeps review non-writing, requires explicit confirmation, and separately authorizes commit while invalidating superseded reviews.
afterHeading: Review, confirmation, and persistence are separate

title: Encrypted Storage & Single-Writer Audit
description: Shows per-write DPAPI protection and restoring the in-memory audit list when persistence fails.
afterHeading: Protected storage and useful audit evidence

title: Accessibility Testing Against the Realised Automation Tree
description: Reads the UI Automation tree exposed by running WPF windows and pins known gaps as testable current behavior.
afterHeading: Verification that shows what was actually checked
